camel_example: aliyun mse EnableProxyProtocol --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-c9bc5afd61014165bd58f621b49100000' --EnableProxyProtocol true --AcceptLanguage zh
description_en: Enables the proxy protocol. When an NLB instance is used as an ingress, you cannot obtain the real IP address of the client if you do not enable the proxy protocol. After you enable the proxy protocol, non-proxy requests are not adversely affected
description_zh: 开启Proxy协议。如果网关入口流量使用NLB接入，如果不开启则无法获取客户端的真实IP，开启后对于非Proxy协议请求没有影响
kebab_example: aliyun mse enable-proxy-protocol --gateway-unique-id gw-c9bc5afd61014165bd58f621b49100000 --enable-proxy-protocol true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableProxyProtocol

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the proxy protocol to preserve client IP addresses. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能，取值：

- **true**：开启保持客户端源IP功能。

- **false**（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能
parameters.name: enable_proxy_protocol

parameters.help_en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
